tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Full details of one Neofort IMO residential project: description, every apartment type with prices and availability (sold units are marked), parking, amenities, distances to metro/schools/shops, FAQ and broker. Works for projects on sale and for sold projects in the portfolio. Accepts the slug, "Neo

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List all Neofort IMO residential projects currently on sale (zone, stage, room types, starting price in EUR excl. VAT, available units). Optionally also the sold projects from the portfolio, as track record.

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Search the Neofort IMO blog (Romanian) about buying property in Bucharest: taxes, VAT, mortgages, legislation, short-term rental, owners associations, neighbourhoods. Returns title, summary, dates and links; read the "markdown" link for the full text. Without a query, returns the latest articles.

tools.name: get_contact
tools.description: How to reach Neofort IMO: phone, WhatsApp, email, office address, opening hours and contact form. With a project, also the broker in charge of it and their phone. Use this to send the person to a human for a firm offer, a viewing or a reservation — this server cannot send requests.

tools.name: calculate_mortgage
tools.description: Indicative monthly mortgage payment, using the same formula as the calculator on neofort.ro. VAT (21%) is added to the price first, because website prices exclude VAT and the bank finances the full price. Give either a price in EUR excluding VAT or a project (its starting price is used). Defaults: 1

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_contact · Private data: list_projects, get_contact · Public sink: get_contact.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_contact · Private data: list_projects, get_contact · Public sink: get_contact

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
